Seven girls drown in Ganga river while bathing in Patna

Seven girls drowned in the Ganga river while bathing near Bakhtiyarpur in Patna. Three girls were rescued, while a search operation is ongoing for the remaining four. The incident occurred at Rani Sarai Ghat.
